title: Syrian Split Peas Stew
description: A traditional Syrian stew made with split peas and cooked in a clay pot, this dish is hearty and comforting. It is also egg-free, making it a great option for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Rinse the split peas and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the split peas, then transfer them to a clay pot.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste to the pan and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cooked onion and garlic mixture to the clay pot with the split peas.
Add the salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika to the clay pot and stir to combine.
Add enough water to the clay pot to cover the split peas and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes, or until the split peas are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
